text:
arjun: Nightly eval alert: doc-summarization promptset shows a sharp quality drop on long-context cases (>= 8k tokens). Rouge-L median down 0.18 vs baseline. Failing samples look like truncated conclusions / repetitions.
lucy: Thanks for flagging. Is this only on the new quant profile we promoted last night?
arjun: Looks correlated — last night we pushed q4_8x kernel pack for the new model variant. Canary ran ok on short contexts but barely covered long docs.
kevin: Hmm, runtime shipped a KV cache stride change yesterday (packed-kv stride=32 -> 16) to improve perf. Could interact with quant kernels.
arjun: I pulled a few failing traces. Key symptoms: repeated final sentence fragments, increased token deletion in the middle. Logs attached below.
arjun: ```
# eval snippet (failed case)
model: redwood-large-v2-q4_8x
input_len: 9300
reference: "...in conclusion, the study recommends X."
output: "...in conclusion, the study recommends"
# rouge-l: 0.21 (baseline ~0.39)
# generation tokens show repeated EOS priors and p(eos) spike at 0.92 around token 8200
```
lucy: p(eos) spike near boundary suggests kv cache misalignment or off-by-one in positional embedding mapping after quant kernels. EVA, any thoughts from eval side?
eva: I ran distribution diffs. Attention score variance increases after step ~1024 in long sequences — matches where KV stride chunking kicks in. Also some delta in softmax temperature but probably downstream effect.
marta: Infra logs show the new kernel pack added a micro-optimization that packs KV pages into 4096-byte blocks. Could cause boundary padding differences.
kevin: If packing changed the effective sequence chunking, and our quantized kernel assumes specific alignment, you can get shifted KV reads leading to attention grabbing wrong tokens -> truncation/repetition.
lucy: Agreed. Two likely contributing changes: (1) q4_8x kernel arithmetic changes, (2) KV stride packing alignment. Combined they break long-context semantics. Short contexts don't trigger it.
arjun: Immediate mitigation proposal: rollback production model variant to redwood-large-v2-q4_8a (previous quant profile) for hosted traffic with context > 6k via routing rule; disable q4_8x for Dedicated canaries for now.
kevin: I'll open infra rollback for the KV packing change and pin stride to 32. Marta can you hold a patch?
marta: On it. Scheduling rollback for kernel packing in the next 30m window.
eva: From eval side I'll add a long-context gating rule to nightly CI: any Rouge-L delta > 0.05 on >=8k subset should block rollout. Also add a targeted promptset of 100 long docs.
lucy: Good. Also add automatic canary traffic split for new quant profiles: 1% traffic with length>4k for 48h before promoting.
arjun: Action items: 
- kevin: rollback KV packing and pin stride (ETA 30m)
- marta: coordinate infra deploy + smoke tests (ETA 45m)
- eva: add gating set + threshold to nightly CI (ETA EOD)
- lucy: update rollout doc + add canary rule (ETA tomorrow)
- arjun: re-run failing evals after rollback and post diff (ETA 1h)
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1145, auto-notify on deploy stages.
kevin: I'll also add a unit test that compares kv-addressing for different packing configs to catch this.
arjun: After rollback and re-eval if metrics recover we will mark this a regression introduced by combined quant+packing changes and add a pre-release long-context benchmark.
lucy: Thanks all — let's keep thread updates here. If anyone is blocked ping me. :thumbsup:
